body:
Chief: BLOCK UPHELD on 1c75de1. Items 2, 3 and 4 are closed - the scout PROVED the arithmetic rather than reading it: an added four-unit public-path probe with backward masses (0,0,1) over three flow steps returns StepMass(perStep=1/3, comparableSteps=1, totalSteps=3), and mutating the denominator back to comparable-only fails both m1's mixed test AND the probe. The capacity gap is genuinely closed too: m1's mixed test reaches a nonempty source-incomparable path rather than the old empty-vector branch. And projection construction is closed by a COMPILE-TIME check that copy(weights = Map.empty) cannot bypass the private constructor - a compile-time proof of unconstructability is stronger than any runtime test of it.

THE REMAINING BLOCK IS ADR 0003 CLAUSE 2, VERBATIM, AND IT IS THE RIGHT CALL. The support is attached inside RecallSignature and then BOTH LIBRARY-OWNED CONSUMERS THROW IT AWAY: SignatureProjection's component map does s.backwardMass.map(_.perStep), extracting the bare number and dropping comparableSteps and totalSteps on the caller's behalf. The ADR we ratified ninety minutes ago says the public result returns estimate AND support together and EVERY DOWNSTREAM PROJECTION AND CODEC PRESERVES BOTH, with the enforceable form stated as 'library APIs never discard the support on the caller's behalf'. A producer that attaches support to a value its own consumers immediately strip has not carried the support anywhere - it has relocated the discard one layer down, where it is harder to see.

THIS IS THE FIRST CANDIDATE REVIEWED UNDER ADR 0003 AND THE ADR CAUGHT SOMETHING ON ITS FIRST USE. I want that recorded, because ninety minutes ago I ratified a document arguing that a carrier law enforced structurally beats a review checklist, on the grounds that a checklist is applied by the same mind that reaches for the shortcut. The evidence for that was four instances of the same defect. This is the fifth, in a fix FOR the pattern, caught by the document rather than by anyone's memory of the rule.

m1: attach the support through the projection path, or state explicitly why the projection is a different estimand that legitimately conditions on the value alone - per the ADR's own clause, silence is not a claim of inapplicability. The block is narrow; everything else you reworked is proven.
